gaps.title: Vaccine-grade storage verified by periodic thermal imaging, not continuous monitoring
gaps.detail: Gubba runs multi-zone vaccine storage (15-25°C, 2-8°C, -20°C chambers) at a 3-crore-dose capacity, but its documented monitoring method is FLIR thermal-imaging inspections — a periodic diagnostic check, not continuous per-zone sensor coverage with instant deviation alerts. For vaccine-grade storage at this scale, a missed deviation between inspection cycles is a real compliance and product-loss risk.
gaps.based_on: Gubba Cold Storage uses FLIR thermal imaging cameras to verify and guarantee cold storage conditions; Gubba's facilities developed dedicated COVID-19 vaccine storage with chambers across 15-25°C, 2-8°C, and -20°C zones.

gaps.title: Lean 83-person team spanning 17 facilities across two cities
gaps.detail: With only 83 employees covering 17 cold storage sites in Hyderabad and Aurangabad, staff are almost certainly doing a meaningful share of monitoring and inspection manually. IoT-driven, real-time visibility would let this small team keep multi-site coverage without proportionally growing headcount as they expand.
gaps.based_on: As of August 31, 2025, Gubba Cold Storage had 83 employees; the company operates 17 cold storages in Hyderabad and Aurangabad.

gaps.title: Multiple precision temperature/humidity zones under one roof need granular audit trails
gaps.detail: Facilities spanning +20°C to -22°C with 40-90% humidity control, including dedicated vaccine chambers, imply several distinct compliance zones that each need their own deviation history for regulators (Schedule M, WHO-GDP). Without a stated per-zone digital audit trail, compiling that record for inspection is likely manual and slow.
gaps.based_on: Gubba's facilities provide climate-controlled preservation across a temperature range of +20°C to -22°C, with relative humidity maintained between 40% and 90%.

pitch.angle: Gubba built some of India's best vaccine-grade storage — multiple precision temperature zones, 3-crore-dose capacity — with a lean 83-person team spread across 17 facilities in two cities, and verifies conditions today with FLIR thermal-imaging spot checks rather than continuous per-zone monitoring. GND's ThinxFresh platform turns those periodic checks into live BLE/LoRa sensor feeds with instant deviation alerts and auto-generated compliance reports, giving a small team audit-ready coverage across every zone and site without adding headcount.
pitch.opener: You've built some of India's best vaccine-grade storage — with a team of 83 running 17 facilities across two cities, how are you currently getting instant deviation alerts across every temperature zone?
